answer: Offers last a limited time, so if yours expired while you waited for your North Carolina duplicate title, you may need to get a new offer. You can get an offer and book an appointment while you wait, but we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. The help center doesn't say whether a new offer will match your original price, so please contact a store for details. Also note that in North Carolina your registration must be current on the day of the sale, so renew it before your appointment if needed.
